Offices of essential jobs were to be staffed at 1/3 of their capacity, all classes were made remote and gatherings limited to 15 people. Less restrictive forms of these measures were also passed in more lightly affected cities and towns. After 2 weeks restrictions were loosened but maintained until at least 19 December 2020, with individual provinces and cities determining specific changes.
